scope: §6.N.1.1 incident-response bluff-hunt (subagent-driven). SAFE evidence-only: production code mutated-then-reverted during rehearsal; only tests + this evidence file committed.
protocol: Per file: identify production path + its test → apply ONE deliberate NON-CRASHING mutation that changes user-visible/observable behavior → run module test (single module, --max-workers=2) → confirm RED localized to the mutated path with verbatim message → revert → confirm GREEN.
host: darwin/arm64; JVM unit tests (no emulator needed — these are pure ViewModel/Orbit tests)

candidates_inspected_but_not_chosen.reason_not_chosen: Already has thorough real-stack coverage in NavigationArgumentTest.kt (13 tests on the built route/path strings — appendRequiredArgs/appendOptionalArgs/appendRequiredParams/appendOptionalParams/buildRoute/buildDeepLink, including the '?' vs '&' boundary and the parent-graph prefix). Not bluff-rich.

CategoryViewModelTest.kt already covers the auth-gate (Authorized→OpenSearch, Unauthorized→ShowLoginDialog), TopicClick id, and FavoriteClick failure path, each with a PERFORMED falsifiability rehearsal in KDoc. Not bluff-rich.

files_hunted.production_path: AccountViewModel.onLogoutClick() — the logout-confirmation gate. The Logout action MUST post ShowLogoutConfirmation (open the confirmation dialog), NEVER fire logout immediately (which would wipe all local user data without a confirm).
files_hunted.mutation: onLogoutClick() body changed from `postSideEffect(AccountSideEffect.ShowLogoutConfirmation)` to `logoutUseCase()` — the §6.AB-class non-crashing gate-bypass: logout fires immediately on first tap, no confirmation. User-data-destroying but does not crash.
files_hunted.observed_failure_verbatim:
AccountViewModelTest > LogoutClick posts ShowLogoutConfirmation FAILED
  app.cash.turbine.TurbineAssertionError: No value produced in 3s
files_hunted.localized: 1 of 4 tests failed — only the LogoutClick gate test; the 3 unrelated tests (auth render, OpenLogin, ConfirmLogout) stayed green, confirming the failure is localized to exactly the mutated path.
files_hunted.reverted: yes — `git diff` shows no .kt change after revert; baseline re-run BUILD SUCCESSFUL (4/4).

files_hunted.production_path: CredentialsManagerViewModel.perform(Unlock) — the credential-vault security gate. A WRONG passphrase MUST set unlockError='Wrong passphrase' and keep the vault LOCKED (unlocked=false, no entries observed). This guards every stored tracker credential (§6.H).
files_hunted.mutation: The wrong-passphrase `else` branch changed from `reduce { state.copy(unlockError = "Wrong passphrase") }` to `reduce { state.copy(unlocked = true, unlockError = null) }; startObservingEntries()` — unlock the vault + expose all stored secrets on a WRONG passphrase. The canonical §6.H/§6.AB security-gate-bypass, non-crashing.
files_hunted.test_that_should_bite: CredentialsManagerViewModelTest > `wrong passphrase shows error and keeps vault locked`
files_hunted.observed_failure_verbatim:
CredentialsManagerViewModelTest > wrong passphrase shows error and keeps vault locked FAILED
  java.lang.AssertionError: wrong passphrase MUST NOT unlock the vault — was unlocked=true
files_hunted.localized: 1 of 8 tests failed — only the wrong-passphrase security gate; the other 7 (correct-unlock, save, delete, first-time-setup, addnew, edit, dismiss-edit) stayed green.
files_hunted.reverted: yes — `git diff` shows no .kt change after revert; baseline re-run BUILD SUCCESSFUL (8/8).

result.summary: Both hunted ViewModel tests are GENUINE anti-bluff tests: each provably catches a real, non-crashing, user-visible (gate-bypass) break in the production path it claims to cover, with the failure localized to exactly the mutated path and a clear assertion message. No bluff, no coverage gap surfaced — the existing tests' documented falsifiability rehearsals are verified real, not bluff-claims. Per §6.N these two tests (feature/account ViewModel layer + feature/credentials_manager security-gate layer) are now bluff-hunt-verified for this cycle.
